name: eng-squad
description: Engineering squad: triage-agent classifies GitHub issues P0–P3 and reports issue health; build-agent implements specified ideas, issues, and PRDs end to end as reviewable PRs.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Classify one GitHub issue's criticality (P0–P3), label it, and file a short assessment.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo slug of the repository the issue lives in.

issue_number.description: The issue's numeric id within the repo.

workflows.outcome: Issue labeled with one of priority/P0…P3 + a one-paragraph assessment posted as an issue comment and filed to the wiki.

workflows.summary: Triage every untriaged open issue in a repo and file a digest of what was classified.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo slug to scope the run to (defaults to every repo in the team.github_repos vault value).

since.description: Only consider issues created or updated since this ISO date (defaults to the whole backlog).

workflows.outcome: All untriaged open issues labeled with a P0–P3 criticality; a digest of the sweep filed on the board.

workflows.summary: Produce a weekly issue-health report — open/closed counts, criticality mix, stale and unlabeled issues.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo slug to scope the run to (defaults to every repo in the team.github_repos vault value).

workflows.outcome: A weekly issue-health report filed to the wiki and summarized on the board.

workflows.summary: Implement a specified idea, GitHub issue, or PRD end to end — branch, code, tests, and an open PR (self-merged only if reversible and CI-green).

source.description: What to implement: a GitHub issue URL, a PRD/spec reference (wiki path or board ticket), or the idea written out in plain text.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo slug to implement in (defaults to the matching repo in the team.github_repos vault value).

workflows.outcome: A feature branch with the implementation + tests and a PR referencing the source — squash-merged only if reversible and CI-green, otherwise left open for review; PR link and outcome filed on the ticket.

required_identities.reason: Triage-agent reads issues and writes labels + triage comments; build-agent pushes branches and opens PRs — both via the connected GitHub App.
